title: Challenge Decks
summary: A Challenge Deck is a preconstructed, self-running theme deck with special Magic: The Gathering cards. It is a player-vs-environment (PvE) experience: the deck follows its own rules and casts its own cards.
points: Challenge cards have special card backs and are not treated as regular Magic cards for constructed formats.
When playing against a Challenge Deck, players may use Hero cards. These begin the game on the battlefield and act like a vanguard-style aid.
Players each have 20 life. In multiplayer, players typically take their turns simultaneously.
Players win by meeting the Challenge Deck’s win condition. The Challenge Deck wins if all players are eliminated.

So far, three Challenge Decks have been released: Face the Hydra (Theros; green card backs), Battle the Horde (Born of the Gods; red card backs), and Defeat a God (Journey into Nyx; indigo card backs). Theros Beyond Death did not include a Challenge Deck.
